description: PERMANENTLY delete an already-deleted repository now, instead of waiting for its restore window to end. IRREVERSIBLE: the git data, LFS objects, issues, PRs, releases, packages, CI history and settings are removed and cannot be restored (data already in the instance's backups ages out on the backup schedule). Only works on a repository already deleted with gluecron_delete_repo; `confirm` must be its full name (owner/name). Owner (personal owner, or an org owner) or a site admin; needs 'admin' scope. Audited as repo.purge. Returns {purged: true, id, full_name}.

confirm.description: The repository's full name, owner/name, to confirm

name: gluecron_purge_repo
